name: Village Guard
description: A stern-looking guard watching over the square.
dialogue: Stay safe, traveler.
The roads south get dangerous past the gate.

name: Master Kael
description: A retired adventurer who trains newcomers.
dialogue: Every hero starts somewhere. Tell me which path you walk.
Archer, fighter, mage or healer: each needs the others.

name: Marta
description: The cheerful owner of the Prancing Pony.
dialogue: A bed and a hot meal? Five coins and you'll be good as new.
Bram at the gate hasn't had a drink all week, poor man.

name: Tomlin the Bard
description: A lute player who knows every rumour in town.
dialogue: They say a king of slime rules the hollow south of the forest edge.
Fire melts ice, water drowns fire... every child knows the song.
A haunted wood west of the chapel, a desert east of the market, a dragon north of the tavern. Pick your doom.

name: Oswin
description: A friendly merchant eager to trade.
dialogue: Welcome to my shop!
Potions, blades, bows, staves. I buy blob jelly too.

name: Sister Liora
description: A priestess tending the village chapel.
dialogue: The light keeps us all.
Our herb stores are empty. The plains past the gate are full of them.

name: Elder Rowan
description: The village elder, old but sharp-eyed.
dialogue: Blobs have been creeping closer to the village every night.
Something commands them. Something big.

name: Gate Warden Bram
description: A tired warden guarding the southern gate.
dialogue: Beyond this gate lie the Verdant Plains. Mind the blobs.
I'd kill for a cold ale.

name: Captain Hilde
description: A scarred veteran in a dented helmet, watching the northern trail.
dialogue: The peaks belong to the dragon. Kobolds, trolls, worse.
Old Thrain still camps on the Windy Ledge. Mad, or brave.

name: Elowen the Druid
description: A druid with leaves in her hair and an owl on her shoulder.
dialogue: The Whisperwood is sick. Blights walk where trees once stood.
An owlbear has claimed the cave south of the glowing glade. Even the wolves avoid it.

name: Zahra the Nomad
description: A desert trader wrapped in indigo cloth, a scimitar at her hip.
dialogue: Water is worth more than gold out here, friend.
The gnolls came from the ruins. The ruins came from the tomb. Nobody comes back from the tomb.

name: Thrain Stonebeard
description: An old dwarf smith who swore to forge the blade that slays Ashfang.
dialogue: Ashfang burned my forge and my clan. I have waited sixty years.
Mithril, lad. Bring me mithril and I'll forge a sword worthy of a dragon.
